name: 夢境之門
description: 雲海上的石板步道，一扇接一扇的門往天邊排下去，每扇門後是不同的世界；執行時她小跑起來、門整排彈開，等你時停在一扇關著的門前回頭看。
description_en: A stone walkway above the clouds with door after door to the horizon, each opening onto a different world. She breaks into a jog while Claude works and stops at a closed door to look back when it needs you.
